chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: Recording with Trumbauer while under contract to Goldkette
summary: Kline asks how the men recorded under Trumbauer's name while with Goldkette and Goldkette did not mind.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I'm going to get up to that. I haven't finished Jean Goldkette yet. While you were with Jean Goldkette you were also recording with Frankie Trumbauer.
How does that work? Did some of the men ... completely went off on their own and make records?
And there's no problem where Jean Goldkette is concerned?
He doesn't mind? He doesn't care?
Why wouldn't he think there no need to mention (unintelligible) records?
We were all too young to know what we were doing (laughter).
You would play jazz, and whoever's name it was under was the leader?
